goal: One big empty cardboard box, large in the middle of a white card, so a child can name it.
colorPrompt: Make one children's book picture. Do not use a reference picture: draw the object from these words. The object: ONE big empty cardboard box. Draw it as a smooth, clean, bright, soft, round 3D render with a plain white background. The picture to make: a square card picture on a plain pure white background: exactly ONE box, large in the middle, filling most of the square, the whole box in view, seen from a three-quarter view, so that its shape reads clearly. Exactly one box: no second one, no copies, and nothing else in the picture. The object has no eyes and no face. The background is plain white and empty, with at most a very soft shadow under the object. A wide empty white margin surrounds the box on every side. The page text is "box" and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
